name: valheim
title: Valheim Server
description: A dedicated Valheim server that installs and updates itself from Steam, with automatic world backups. Friends join with the server name and password; forward UDP 2456-2457 on your router for players outside the LAN. The first start downloads the server (a few minutes).

variables.name: PORT_VALHEIM
variables.label: Game port
variables.description: UDP; the query port is always this + 1

variables.name: VALHEIM_PASSWORD
variables.label: Server password
variables.description: At least 5 characters and not part of the server name
